sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI says prompt caching was available in May 2025, but this excerpt gives no Grok 3 cache price or pricing effective date.

sources.quote:
| Model | Context | Input / 1M tokens | Cached input / 1M tokens | Output / 1M tokens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| grok-4.7 (< 200k prompt tokens) | 500k | $2.00 | $0.50 | $6.00 |
sources.supports: The current provider pricing page exposes cached input rates but does not list Grok 3, so it cannot establish Grok 3's historical cache rate.

notes: The provider confirms prompt caching existed before the models.dev record, but the accessible primary sources do not establish whether Grok 3's cache_read/cache_write rates were already official then or when those rates took effect. Internet Archive retrieval of the provider pricing history failed with HTTP 503, so the classification and effective date remain unclear.
